first_line: Monitor, isolate affected plants, remove heavily infested material and use a directed water spray where appropriate.
chemical_note: Neem/azadirachtin products may be considered only where the current product label permits the use.

first_line: Inspect leaves regularly and remove small infestations manually where practical.
chemical_note: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) biological products can be considered for susceptible caterpillars when label-approved.

first_line: Prioritize drainage, avoid persistent waterlogging, improve airflow and remove diseased material.
chemical_note: Biological options such as Trichoderma may be considered where appropriate and label-approved.
